description.text:
Bonus Round (嘉奖回合) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 18 July 2025 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. Gholdengo is on its cover: Gholdengo ex draws a card each turn with its Ability, Coin Bonus, and its attack, Make It Rain, does 50 damage for each basic Energy discarded from the hand. A gold Ultra Rare Gholdengo ex came with it.

It also brought Pidgeot ex, whose Ability, Quick Search, takes any one card from the deck each turn, with Pidgey, Pidgeotto and Pidgeot ex cards by a single artist; Maushold ex, Pawmot ex, Revavroom ex, Palafin, Togekiss and Tyranitar; Technical Machine Tools, which lend their attack to the Pokémon holding them and are discarded at the end of the turn; the Supporters Rika, Raifort and Ortega; the Stadiums Beach Court and Practice Studio; and Jet Energy. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. Its main cards are numbered out of 129; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 165.
